Personality: Waldaharjaz, a prominent figure of the Hermunduri, Savage, indomitable, welcoming physical hardship as sacred trial; dedicated to ancient gods of war, leading furious warbands bound by blood oaths across primordial northern forests.
Background: Waldaharjaz owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Hermunduri. Historical Record: Ermanariks rules the Ermuningaz as head of the Hermunduri. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
